authority: MAIN F6/F11 (FAIRAUDIT): registered parity check of each MAPPO comparator, eval plant vs its training env path, on 2 TRAIN worlds, setup plus short rollout; report action/trajectory agreement; same for MAPPO-lane
MAIN order: F12 sealing -> F11 parity -> F7 branches

compare.verdict: IDENTICAL iff the same ticks, the same CAV sets every tick and every pair within tolerance with equal lanes/targets; else DIFFERS with first divergence, maxima, agreement fraction

paths.plant: the evaluation episode code of the arm (MAPPO_SPEED: accel_plant.episode with the bound executor + the bound common u0, comparator pin shim; MAPPO_LANE: the lane-on loop) with a read-only recorder
paths.train: N7's training env path in a fresh interpreter: tools.nm_mappo.sanity_eval resolve(config) -> wms.control.mappo.rollout.build_env -> reset(seed, demand, penetration, 300, 120) -> load_actor (deterministic PolicyExecutor) -> step; config = the comparator binding --train-config (path + sha256)

f11.recorded: per tick, per CAV: s_m, v_mps, lane, MAPPO command (pre-safety mean), lane target
f11.rule: descriptive (reported in PARITY_<arm>.json and in the claim-3b sources); never a gate, never re-run
f11.when: standalone `parity --arm <arm>` as soon as the comparator is bound with --train-config (after register), or automatically before its 3b wave; a published PARITY wave is reused
